proposition: Ibn Turka saw the new phase of human evolution as heralded by a celestial conjunction, which Melvin-Koushki thinks is probably the Saturn-Jupiter conjunction in Scorpio of 767/1365 but says he is not certain.

mediation.note: We have the work only as MK summarises or translates it; most of the lettrist works are unedited, so MK's paraphrase cannot be checked against a printed text.
